en: A black‑and‑white postcard view taken from a steel bridge, looking across a wide river toward a historic European city skyline. Prominent church towers and old multi‑story buildings line the far bank. The iron trusses and railing of the bridge frame the picture in the foreground. The words "LATVIJA" appear at the lower left and "RĪGA" at the lower right, with a small emblem beside them.
